WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total
  FROM scanfeatures
),
shares AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         s.artifact_count,
         s.artifact_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.artifact_total, 0) AS share
  FROM site_totals AS s
  CROSS JOIN overall_total AS t
  WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         artifact_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT zoneref,
       artifact_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM averaged
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: If the overall artifact total is zero, shares are undefined; the query treats them as missing, so the missing average condition yields no rows.
